subject.title: fix(macos): stop Canvas presents from stealing focus

question: Should explicit agent Canvas presentation permanently adopt the non-key, nonactivating contract that requires a click before typing into Canvas?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes an existing interaction contract, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even though the implementation is narrowly scoped.

options.title: Accept the nonactivating contract
options.body: Merge after rebasing and after real macOS evidence confirms agent presentation leaves the current app focused while menu or Dock entry still activates OpenClaw.

options.title: Preserve automatic focus
options.body: Keep the prior key-window behavior for explicit agent presentation if immediate Canvas keyboard entry is the intended product contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the nonactivating contract
recommendation.body: Merge after rebasing and after real macOS evidence confirms agent presentation leaves the current app focused while menu or Dock entry still activates OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work establishes the Canvas visibility and presentation boundary affected by this follow-up.
